Options:
  -e, --environment ENVIRONMENT  Select build environments
  -t, --target TARGET  Select project targets
  -d, --project-dir DIRECTORY  Select project directory
  -c, --project-conf FILE  Select project configuration
  -j, --jobs JOBS  Set concurrent jobs
  --upload-port PORT  Select upload port
  -v, --verbose  Increase output detail
  -s, --silent  Suppress progress output
  --list-targets  List available targets
  --disable-auto-clean  Disable automatic cleanup
